title: Megabase DNA Extraction from Animal Blood
author: Huang Zhihai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gagbsbw

steps.title: Collect and Store Blood
steps.instruction: Collect 3mL of animal blood in a 5 mL EDTA anticoagulative tube and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Homogenize White Blood Cells
steps.instruction: Mix the blood by gently rocking for 10 minutes at room temperature to ensure a homogenous WBC distribution.

steps.title: Perform First RBC Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse red blood cells using RBC lysis solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 3mL blood to a 15mL screw cap tube containing 9mL RBC lysis solution (3 volumes).
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, mixing by inverting at least once during incubation.

steps.title: Isolate Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pipet out the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Perform Second RBC Lysis
steps.instruction: Further wash and lyse the cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 3mL PBS (1 blood volume).
Add 9mL RBC lysis solution (3 volumes), invert to mix, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension and thoroughly remove all liquid.

substeps.instruction: Spin cell suspension for 5 minutes at 2000xg at 4⁰C.
Carefully pipet out the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Remove the last drop of liquid by tilting the tube and removing liquid with a pipet tip.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspensions
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and divide into specific concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 580µL cell suspension buffer (Bio Rad plug lysis kit) until the suspension is homogenous.
Transfer 375µL to a new microfuge tube and label as (400).
Transfer 187.5µL to another tube labeled (200), add 187.5µL cell suspension buffer, and pipet mix gently 5x.
Keep both tubes on ice until ready for agarose embedding.

steps.title: Prepare Agarose
steps.instruction: Melt 2% agarose (Bio Rad kit) by immersing it in microwave-boiled water for 10-15 minutes until completely melted.

steps.title: Equilibrate Samples
steps.instruction: Equilibrate both prepared cell tubes in a 43°C water bath or heat block for at least 5 minutes before use.

steps.title: Cast Agarose Plugs
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 plugs from one tube, performing steps rapidly to prevent solidification before pipeting into the plug mold.

steps.title: Solidify Plugs
steps.instruction: Solidify the agarose plugs on ice.

substeps.instruction: Place the plug cast on ice for at least 45 minutes or until the agarose has solidified.
Alternatively, place the plug cast on an inverted metal microfuge ice block on ice for 45 minutes to avoid contact between agarose and ice.

steps.title: Wash Plugs
steps.instruction: Wash away hemoglobin and cellular material using Proteinase K and WashBuffer.
